title: [question] How to create / generate a big, detailed map?
author: Brilliant_Feed4158
selftext:
I'm building a game where the player travels on a large island from location to location. The island looks like this: 

https://preview.redd.it/v31bxxf890sh1.png?width=1262&format=png&auto=webp&s=55ea4237430941fdf0d5627d110fd009e0cd82ce

https://preview.redd.it/vwr65h0i90sh1.png?width=827&format=png&auto=webp&s=f63d5ffdedd267dae49db4ed420a8d3c8ff01f7f

I would like to make everything pretty detailed. The details themselves don't really matter, AI can come up with whatever (within prompt). Here's a first attempt at making a part of the island, it's perfect!

Ideally I would like to generate this x40 for every piece of the island and then put them all together. Zo you can zoom out and see mostly the island and the nature, but when you zoom in you see that the world is alive. 

I tried cutting of a 10% edge and feed it a prompt to "work from this example and NOT CHANGE THE sample." Because then I can glue them all together.

But as you all know this is very hard for an LLMs. It keeps changing the edge, making it impossible to glue it together.  
  
What are your suggestions? Thanks :)

comments.author: Fuzz-Monster
comments.body: Terrain displacement maps (real-world or synthetic) can be blended together pretty easily. It simplifies the problem to blending 2D b&w image tiles.

replies.author: Brilliant_Feed4158
replies.body:
I had to ask an LLM what your post exactly means, so apologies if I misunderstand.

Right now the seam is the problem. When I generate two images the edges are different. I can put them together, but when you zoom in the trees etc are cut off.

comments.author: No-Association-1834
comments.body:
Let me understand this ,you want to leave the border trees of the map as is and  extract the internal region , have it regenerated with AI and put it back seamlessly ? If I understood that correctly and that is what you want then try this -https://creators-quest.blogspot.com/p/patchfit-image-20.html 

Edit : There is no AI image generator ,it's only an algorithm that handles extraction and  putting back together part .

replies.author: Brilliant_Feed4158
replies.body:
Oh that looks good! I am going to try it!

What I am trying to achieve:
You see the large world map. I want to be able to zoom in and see the world as detailed as the image.

Unfortunately I cannot generate a huge 30,000x40,000px map.

So the solution is to generate 5x6 = 30 images that I would like to stitch together. But you can only do that if the edges MATCH or else you get a seam on the edge.

Im looking for a solution to make it seamless. Going to try your tool.
